articles.title: Nandan Nilekani Sees AI Opportunity for Infosys
articles.summary: Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani says AI is driving the biggest transformation in IT services in decades, creating new opportunities for businesses and Infosys. He discusses AI adoption, legacy systems and the company’s model-agnostic approach. He spoke with Shery Ahn at NEF in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Companies rushed in on AI. Now some are pulling back
articles.summary: Rapid AI adoption left workers cleaning up a flood of errors and low-quality workEmployers around the globe are grappling with the fallout from rushing to adopt fast-changing artificial intelligence tools.Meta has scaled back plans to axe staff and use more AI agents after the company found employees were spending more and more time cleaning up technical and security errors, Reuters reported. And after thinning its workforce, especially middle managers, in a 2023 efficiency push, the company is expanding its managerial ranks again, LinkedIn posts from workers show. Continue reading...
